claim: A parallax ceiling is not drawn but it still bounds players and enemies: MoveDude asks GetZRange with PARALLAXCLIP_CEILING, which keeps the sky sector's own ceiling z, so a low sky over walkable ground is an invisible ceiling a jump hits. Things (MoveThing) ask without it, and a sky does not stop them.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/gameutil.cpp:739-740 GetZRange: only without PARALLAXCLIP_CEILING is a parallax ceiling's z replaced by 0x80000000; actor.cpp:4598 and :4647 (MoveDude) pass PARALLAXCLIP_CEILING, actor.cpp:4305 (MoveThing) does not
NBlood/source/build/src/clip.cpp:2032 getzrange takes the sector's ceiling from getzsofslope with no test of ceilingstat bit 0
bloodmap/skyline.py: REACH (three bodies) is the height under which an apron's sky would be a ceiling to jump into, and apron refuses it
Functions: gameutil.cpp:709 GetZRange; actor.cpp:4435 MoveDude, :4258 MoveThing; clip.cpp:1991 getzrange; skyline.py:77 REACH, :99-102 the refusal.
use: Keep any sky over walkable ground at least three bodies above it; skyline.apron refuses a lower one.

checked.how: gameutil.cpp:739-740 in GetZRange: ceilZ = 0x80000000 only if (nClipParallax & PARALLAXCLIP_CEILING) == 0 and ceilingstat&1; gameutil.h:81 default nClipParallax = 0. actor.cpp:4598 and :4647 are in MoveDude (from :4435) and pass PARALLAXCLIP_CEILING|FLOOR; :4305 in MoveThing (from :4258) passes none. clip.cpp:2032 getzrange calls getzsofslope with no ceilingstat test. skyline.py:77 REACH = 3 * STANDING_HEIGHT, apron raises below it (:99-102).
